units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 97a:10">B. Kam. 97ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>המלוה … על המ׳ ונפסלה המ׳</he> if one loans money in a certain coin, and that coin was afterwards repealed, <he>נותן לו מ׳ היוצא וכ׳</he> he must pay him in the present legal coin.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97b:1">Ib. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>המלוה … על המ׳ והוסיפו עליו</he> if one loans &c., and the coin was in the meantime made larger (heavier), <he>נותן לו מ׳ היוצאת וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 45b:4">B. Mets. 45ᵇ</cite>, sq., v. <cite ref="H01058"><he>חֲלִיפִים</he></cite>.—B. Kam. l. c. <he>מ׳ של א״א</he> the Abraham medal; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַטְבֵּיעוֹת</he>, <he>מַטְבֵּעוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:2">B. Mets. II, 2</cite> <he>שלשה מ׳ זה וכ׳</he> three coins heaped upon another, v. <cite ref="M00120"><he>מִגְדָּל</he></cite>. Y. ib. 8ᵇ <he>שלשה מ׳ של וכ׳</he> three coins of three different kings; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 18:1">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVIII</cite> <he>עשה כל התורה כולה מ׳ מ׳</he> (v. ed. Schechter note 5) he assorted the entire law (like) coins, i.e. systematized.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:8">Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא תשנו מַטְבֵּיעָהּ של וכ׳</he> that you do not change the formula of a benediction.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:8">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>אומר מ׳ ברכה</he> he recites the regular form of the benediction. Ib. VI, 10ᵇ bot. <he>כל המשנה על המ׳ וכ׳</he> (read <he>מן</he>) he who changes the formula of prayers which the scholars have fixed.
<cite ref="Gittin 5b">Gitt. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כל המשנה ממ׳ וכ׳</he> he who changes the formulas of documents &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:7:6">Y. Meg. III, end, 74ᶜ</cite> <he>משה התקין מַטְבֵּיעָהּ של וכ׳</he> Moses introduced as a type of prayer, O God, the great &c.; a. fr.
